title: EDM: Wire EDM has no wire tool kind, and the Sinker Electrode has no visible Sinker EDM machine

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
The maintainer reported this in chat on 2026-11-15, on v0.21.0. His words:

> bug; we can see Wire EDM - but not Sinker EDM - but we can add Sinker Electrode from tooling, but there is no Wire EDM tool. :D

## What happens

- The user can select Wire EDM (machine and operations). The tool library offers no wire tool kind for it.
- The tool library offers a Sinker Electrode. The user cannot select Sinker EDM (no machine or operations to see).

The two EDM kinds are each half visible, and the halves do not match.

## Expected

- Each machine kind that the user can select has its tool kind in the tool library. Wire EDM has a wire tool (diameter, material, and the data that the wire operations read).
- A tool kind is offered only when its machine kind can be selected. Thus Sinker EDM becomes visible (see #1135: the sinker template is not in the built-in machine library), or the Sinker Electrode stays hidden until it is.

## For the work

1. Find where the wire operations get the wire diameter now (the machine file or an operation parameter). State it in the PR.
2. Find why Sinker EDM is not visible. If #1135 is the full cause, link it and do the work there.
3. If a wire tool kind changes what the wire operations read for the kerf, the work is under the safety floor. Raise the effort label then.

## Done means

- With a Wire EDM machine, the user can add and select a wire tool, and the wire operations use it.
- Sinker EDM and the Sinker Electrode are visible together, or hidden together.
- A test pins the two cases.
